statement: Separate hardware usability -> procedures -> tactical employment -> command architecture; years of combat turn reliable radio into doctrine incrementally.
GT clean-radio comparison drives EMI/shielding/filtering acceptance; no fighter-doctrine change yet.
Priority aircraft radio becomes reliable enough for check/ack/lost-comms/route-report procedure; fighter impact still uneven.
China war normalizes mission check-in, join-up, contact, recall, rejoin and diversion calls in experienced aviation units.
Three-plane shotai retained but radio permits looser task separation, altitude split, detach/rejoin and escort reassignment; dogfight remains pilot-centric.
China/Nomonhan lessons spread alert, patrol sector/altitude, reserve and warning-to-launch procedures inside each service.
A6M China escort/sweeps exploit radio for multi-chutai assembly, cover/reserve and rejoin; organizational skeleton remains historical.
First-line Navy training standardizes contact/bearing/altitude, engage-hold-cover-rejoin-return, escort handoff and CAP relief procedures.
Ship/cell plot -> CAP leader -> shotai leader chain; Type21 plugs into existing procedure. Coarse vectoring only, no continuous precision GCI.
No synchronized volley/finger-four; radio changes attack sequencing, cover/reserve assignment, disengage/rejoin and duplicate-pursuit control.
Retain EMI/no-precision-GCI guards from V26:77-78 but supersede any reading that fighter tactics remained static through 1937-42.
Instantiate Apr29 CarDiv5 fighter-control package from the 1932-42 timeline, then run A14/A16/A18 to valid-release bands.
